title: Concept: Dependency declared with an empty version specifier
description: package.json declares an empty dependency specifier, which npm reads as `*`, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: An empty specifier accepts any version, so the lockfile decides what runs and a fresh install can resolve a version nobody reviewed.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package.json (npm).
risk: An empty specifier accepts any version, so the lockfile decides what runs and a fresh install can resolve a version nobody reviewed.
